header.range: 25-year Meteorological and Solar Monthly & Annual Climatologies (January 2001 - December 2025)
header.title: NASA/POWER Source Native Resolution Climatology Climatologies

climate_center_point.usage: Earth context only; excluded from cross-body topographic distance.

limitations: NASA POWER is a coarse center-point climatology, not a footprint-wide measurement.
JRC no-data pixels are unknown, and code zero means no water detected rather than proof of dry ground.
No independent ice or geology layer is included.

water_occurrence.meaning: Historical detected surface water, not current surface dryness or a land-fraction estimate.
